import io

# Dataset provided as a string

"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame

# Convert 'date' column to datetime objects (optional for this specific plot, but good practice)

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create the bar plot
